start: Member page of a member with a running plan

user_sees: Sheet 'Member card' with the card drawn in the gym's colours
Buttons 'Print', 'Download picture', 'Send on WhatsApp'
must_not: Another member's name, photo or plan on the card

user_sees: The browser's print window with the card and 'Cut along the line.'
must_not: The member page behind the sheet printed with it

start: Member card sheet open (other things to do with the card: a picture, WhatsApp)

user_sees: Toast 'Card saved as a picture.' and a picture file is saved
must_not: A blank or cut-off picture

user_sees: WhatsApp opens in a new tab on this member's number with a message already typed
must_not: The message sent without the person pressing send in WhatsApp
Another member's number

steps.action: Tap 'Download picture' when the picture cannot be made
user_sees: Toast 'Could not make the picture. Try Print.'
must_not: 'Card saved as a picture.' with no file

steps.action: Tap 'Send on WhatsApp' for a member whose mobile is not a real number
user_sees: WhatsApp opens with the message typed and no chat picked
must_not: A chat opened with a wrong number

steps.action: Open the card, close the sheet
user_sees: The member page as it was
must_not: Anything saved about the member
A mark that a card was printed

steps.action: Renew the plan, open the card again
user_sees: The card shows the new valid-till date
must_not: The old date on the card

steps.action: Read the card and scan its QR with a phone camera
user_sees: The QR gives only the member's ID
must_not: The member's name or phone number inside the QR
The member's address, dues or notes printed on the card
